ai_rules: DO NOT INVENT TANGIBLE RECORDS — answer only from indexed records
Distinguish SOURCE FACTS from the GENERATED OBJECT (commemorative medallion, never 'the invention')
Never claim a medallion was physically printed or print-tested (PRINT_TESTED=false archive-wide)
Spec records are DRAFTS — never filed/granted/patented
description: 3D-printable keepsake medallions for every Signature spec draft and public patent record. Free STL/OBJ/3MF downloads, generated in the browser.
gcode: No universal G-code is shipped; slice the STL in your own slicer.
honesty: Each tangible is a commemorative emblem FOR its record — not a functional replica of the invention described.
id_standard: The permanent tangible ID IS the source record ID (JAH-SPEC-######, JAH-PAT-######, or patent publication number). One source record <-> one medallion.
